{{Quote|The place is ''alive'' with comets and meteors&hellip;!''"<br />"''Fragments of long exploded stars and planets&hellip; they form the ''dust'' of the Red Nebula.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Klysk]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 50">[[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars'' (1977) 50]]</ref>}}
The '''Red Nebula comet field''' was a dangerous barrier that ringed the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]]. It was formed when the [[Nebula/Legends|Nebula]] was separated from the rest of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Its presence lead to the devastation of the [[Planet of the Red Nebula]].
